stage: fixed variance-matched robust design; corrected during mathematical review before execution or outcomes
plain_gaussian_decision: rejected unscored after frozen source-only pilot; preserve original source, selection and result
plain_rejection_evidence: July 13's extra-source innovation has squared Mahalanobis distance 283.82 and induces a median 9.28-standard-deviation shift while contracting delay variance by 50.9%.

proposed_fixed_rule.q: r_B^T C_BB^-1 r_B using original extra covariance
proposed_fixed_rule.label: one-step Student-style robust Gaussian-moment conditioning, followed prospectively by unchanged 3D t5; not exact Student conditioning

review.status: mathematically coherent; no substantive PSD or influence flaw found
review.PSD: For delta=C_AB*C_BB^-1*C_BA, new covariance=(1-w)*C_AA+w*(C_AA-delta). It is a convex combination of the original and positive-definite Schur covariance.
review.equivalent_noise: Adding independent observation noise (1/w-1)*C_BB to B leaves A and cross covariance unchanged and produces exactly the proposed formulas.
review.bounded_influence: For k>=1, sqrt(q)*min(1,(5+k)/(3+q)) <= sqrt(k+2). The whitened-A shift is additionally scaled by canonical correlation at most one.
review.outlier_limit: As q grows through increasing innovation magnitude, the mean shift and covariance contraction both tend to zero.
review.target_scope: The target has zero B contribution, so B mean/covariance and q/w do not depend on the target support state or own-target removal. One weight is shared within a cohort.
review.control: No-extra and entirely zero cross-covariance messages recover original moments exactly; q=k+2 is the continuous cap junction.
review.score_precision: For t5 scatter=.6*CBB, the gradient in innovation is -(5+k)/(3+q)*CBB^-1*r. Capping this Gaussian-relative precision at one is deliberately conservative.

limitations: This uses the exact variance-matched t5 score weight with an explicit conservative cap, but remains a one-step hybrid Gaussian-moment approximation, not exact Bayesian t conditioning.
A large residual can indicate a wrong prior rather than a bad public observation, so downweighting can suppress correct new evidence.
A single anomalous added cell downweights all added cells jointly.
Moderate cross-runway source-error correlation remains uncalibrated and can still cause excessive contraction.
Bounded influence and covariance contraction establish numerical properties, not expected RMSE improvement.
Global q/k/w means adding disconnected coordinates beside an informative block can change the correction; disconnected recovery refers only to the entire extra set having zero cross covariance.
prospective_checks: Continuity at q=k+2 and unchanged q<=k+2 behavior.
Coordinate permutation invariance and the analytic whitened influence bound.
Positive-definite covariance under extreme innovations without repair.
Retain all twelve fixed pilot cohorts and original plain result; no residual-selected exclusion, gate or weight search.
independent_review: model_diversity independently agrees PSD, bounded influence and cohort-level weighting, with the same approximation cautions.

initial_unexecuted_review.equivalent_noise: Adding independent observation noise (1/w-1)*C_BB to B leaves A and cross covariance unchanged and produces exactly the proposed formulas.
initial_unexecuted_review.bounded_influence: The original-A-whitened shift norm is at most rho*sqrt(q)*min(1,(nu+k)/(nu+q)), with rho<=1 from joint PSD. Its maximum is (nu+k)/(2*sqrt(nu)) for k<=nu, otherwise sqrt(k). For pilot k=2, the bound is about 1.565 standard deviations.

initial_unexecuted_review.control: No-extra and zero-cross-covariance messages recover the original moments exactly; q=k is the continuous junction with the unchanged Gaussian update.

correction_provenance: The initial 5+q denominator was never executed. Review reconciled the inherited t5 scatter=.6*CBB convention and root fixed 3+q before freeze; no weight scan or held outcomes.
